posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
Today we got another OblivAeon Kickstarter update, and this one not only gave us the as-of-now percentages on how far along all the bits and pieces are:

  • OblivAeon Heroes: 95% complete
  • OblivAeon Villain Scenario: 85% complete
  • OblivAeon Environments: 95% complete
  • Benchmark Mini-Expansion: 100% complete
  • Stuntman Mini-Expansion: 100% complete
  • Void Guard Mini-Expansion: 99% complete

but it also gave us a glimpse at some cards from each core OblivAeon Hero deck!

And since a thread was made for the Void Guard, I figure we could use one for this new reveal as well!

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
If Luminary's focus is gonna be dumping cards into his trash to use his death beam, he is gonna be way fun to play. :D (And then you think about Termi-Nation Bunker's "put a deck in its trash" incap power and, well...)

One of the cards (don't have it in front of me, can't remember whose) features flavor text from what sounds like a relative of Haka's? I don't think we've seen that name before!

I didn't think I could be more excited about Akash'Thriya, but I am now! :D Also La Comodora.

And finding out how the Harpy's control tokens work... Sounds like she's going to have some major potential for collateral damage. :B

I hope there's a post about the rest of the new heroes, because I really want to find out how Idealist and Benchmark work...

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
Lifeline and La Comadora seem like they'll be cool too.

La Comadora looks like she not only has some deck manipulation but possibly a few of what I like to call 'burner cards': cards that require you to feed them cards or they burn themselves out(example: gattling gun).

From the little peek of Lifeline's cards, he's going to be good friends with anyone who can heal him. Lots of self damaging but never-the-less powerful cards. You gotta love a hero that can destroy multiple ongoings in a single play.
